submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 is recommended with a threshold of 30 GeV because it achieves the highest signal efficiency (91.762%) among all three candidate algorithms across the evaluated threshold range. This represents a significant improvement of 6.553 percentage points over Algorithm-L1 (85.209% at 30 GeV) and 19.207 percentage points over Algorithm-L2 (72.555% at 30 GeV). The 30 GeV threshold is optimal for Algorithm-L3, providing maximum efficiency while remaining well within the allowed range of 20-60 GeV. The analysis confirms that this configuration meets both the hardware deployability requirement for Level-1 trigger systems and the allocated trigger rate constraint of 8 kHz. This selection directly fulfills the primary goal of achieving the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
